responsibility: Register librarians with unique username/password, enforce password strength, and authenticate access by validating credentials (RF-01..RF-08, RNF-51..RNF-53). Owns its credential data store; stores credentials protected, not plaintext.

Register, delete, and prevent duplicate books; validate obligatory data; list and search books by identifier, title, or availability (RF-09..RF-14, RF-29..RF-33, RF-38). Owns its book data store. On book deletion, notifies Lending Service to remove linked loans (RF-14, RNF-56).

Register and delete readers eligible for loans, prevent duplicates, validate obligatory data, and list/search readers by identifier or name (RF-15..RF-20, RF-34..RF-38). Owns its reader data store. On reader deletion, notifies Lending Service to remove linked loans (RF-20, RNF-56).

Register loans of books to registered readers with loan date, enforce single-borrower-per-book, allow multiple books per reader, and provide adaptive loan form support with immediate results (RF-21..RF-28, RF-39..RF-42). Owns its loan data store. Validates registered book/reader via Book Catalog and Borrower Services (RF-23, RF-24) and removes loans on cascade-deletion notifications from those services (RF-14, RF-20, RNF-56).

Demo environment administration exposing reset/recreate/restore operations via DbServlet to return the system to a clean state for testing (RF-43..RF-45, RNF-62). Note: destructive HTTP operations currently lack access control (RNF-68).
communicates_with: Authentication Service;Book Catalog Service;Borrower Service;Lending Service
